objective: MUSITU Axiom five-year frontier engineering objective
upload_policy: The v5 OpenAI skill profile may proceed to portal validation only from a CI-certified package at or after an objective-passing head SHA, while preserving the sealed v4 production surface and current OpenAI policy boundaries.

evidence: Playwright live navigation/screenshot verification against MUSITU documentation

evidence: six verified paths: image, audio, speech transcription, video, camera-stream frames and screen capture

evidence: sealed unseen comparative holdout against independent SymPy baseline

claim_boundary: PASS certifies the repository-defined five-year frontier engineering objective at the cited head and evidence set. It does not prove global world-best status, generic superiority over every competitor, or guarantee future five-year market leadership; those require continuing comparative and longitudinal evidence.
